notes.title: The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
notes.notes:
The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
In the DEMO version, you can play Caravan mode (3 minute score attack).
If you like it, please add it to your wishlist and wait for the release of the product version.
Thank you for your continuous support. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/[/url]

notes.title: Full version release
notes.notes:
The full version of Raging Blasters will be released.
It will be offered at a 15% OFF price for one week after launch.

Full version including caravan mode and arcade mode. In arcade mode, many bosses will appear and it will be fun to use sub-weapons effectively. Have fun.

*The full version and the free demo version have separate online boards.

notes.notes: Free demo version has been released. It is only available in caravan mode. And it supports online ranking. Have fun!
